summary: Revised comprehensive production engineering implementation plan for BRICS AgriNet incorporating senior engineering feedback: existing-vs-new codebase audit, IndexedDB & PWA offline layer with Web Locks and server idempotency, pure domain architecture with branded units and Zod contracts, FAO-56 golden tests and fast-check invariants, server hardening with split health checks, strict TypeScript & CI/CD quality gates, bundle budgets, Definition of Done per step, risks, rollout plan, ADRs, and open questions.
